metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: Italian (short form). HAI persona takes only the shortest cues (Hi · Ola · Hej · Ciao). Rotated off week 1's 'Ola' and week 2's 'Hej' so the series never repeats a language.
metadata.color_semantics: Claude FIDELITY skin: cream #F2F0E9 stage, warm ink #3D3929, terracotta #D97757 as the ONE accent. The Mycroft figures use crimson #C8102E for the data series and ochre #C8860E for annotation; both remap onto the Claude accent grammar. Palette change only, no data change. Same treatment as weeks 1 and 2.
